args.title: Document additional response fields for GET /uploads/:id
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The API reference for the endpoint `GET /uploads/:id` needs to be updated to include additional fields returned in the response. Specifically, the response also carries `id`, `filename`, `createdAt`, and `finishedAt`, which should be documented alongside the existing fields.
